_comment: Every secret name .github/workflows/** reads, and the ONE scope it is provisioned in.
tools/workflow-secrets-guard.py holds the workflows to this file statically (in CI) and, when
run with a token that can read the secret inventory, checks this file against the live scopes,
printing names only, never values. secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN is the runner-issued token and is not
listed. A scope of environment:<name> means only a job declaring that environment can read it;
the guard fails when a job reads such a name without declaring the environment, which is the
exact defect that left the ESP32 release path referencing names no scope had ever held.
provisioned:false marks a name that is DECLARED but not set anywhere yet. It is a standing to-do,
not an exemption: the workflow reading it must fail fast NAMING it rather than dying obscurely
downstream, and the guard requires that fail-fast step to exist.
Every name here is asserted set/unset by branch-protection-audit.yml on its weekly run, one job
per scope so each job can read exactly what its scope allows. `--assert-present` compares that
against this file, and `--assert-present` coverage of every declared name is itself checked
statically in CI, so adding a secret here without an assertion is a red build.

BOOTSTRAP_TFVARS.purpose: bootstrap-apply.yml: the OpenTofu bootstrap root's variable file

BRANCH_PROTECTION_TOKEN.purpose: branch-protection-audit.yml: administration:read, the only way to read main's live protection rule

HOP_SYNC_TOKEN.purpose: changelog.yml and pr-automerge.yml: cross-repo contents and pull-request writes

MIRROR_SECRET_AUDIT_TOKEN.purpose: branch-protection-audit.yml: reads secret METADATA (names only) on the hopmesh mirrors, to catch a mirror release workflow referencing a credential nobody seeded
MIRROR_SECRET_AUDIT_TOKEN.blocked_on: no such PAT exists yet; it needs 'secrets: read' on the hopmesh mirrors plus admin:org for organization-scoped secrets. Until it is added, the mirror-secret audit job FAILS rather than reporting a green skip, and the equivalent check is `python3 tools/release/check-mirror-secrets.py` run by hand. Deleting that job is the other legitimate resolution.

HOP_SYNC_APP_ID.purpose: sync-components.yml, release-tags.yml: the mirror-writing GitHub App

HOP_SYNC_APP_PRIVATE_KEY.purpose: sync-components.yml, release-tags.yml: the mirror-writing GitHub App

NATIVE_ARTIFACT_SIGNING_KEY.purpose: native-artifacts.yml: signs the native release manifest the mirrors verify

STRIPE_API_KEY.purpose: billing-catalog.yml: the Stripe provider credential for the billing root

RESEND_API_KEY.purpose: billing-catalog.yml: the Resend provider credential for the billing root
